text: Should the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute be emitted unconditionally for every generated type (with a fallback such as an internal polyfill on netstandard2.0), or only on targets where it exists?
options: Guard with #if and omit on netstandard2.0/.NET Framework (current)
Emit a polyfill attribute so every target is excluded
why_it_matters: The requirement says all generated code should be decorated. Under the guard, netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework consumers still skew coverage, so the requirement is not met there. A polyfill would satisfy it fully.

text: Should generated code on NETSTANDARD2_0/NETFRAMEWORK targets also carry ExcludeFromCodeCoverage?
options: Yes, always emit it, since the attribute exists on those targets
No, skip it on those targets, as the guard intends
why_it_matters: If yes, the conditional guards are unneeded and the requirement is unmet on those targets. If no, the guard is intentional, but EnumTemplate is still inverted.
